entities.summary: Third Dynasty, a political institution in Iraq during Sumerian Civilization and the Dawn of History (2112 BCE–2004 BCE). Grew from Sargon of Akkad unifies Mesopotamia — first known empire in history and Composition of the Epic of Gilgamesh, the oldest great literary work. Led to the emergence of Third Dynasty of Ur.
